purpose: We develop and validate a stroke risk prediction model for patients with atrial fibrillation. Statistics are not enough because the model needs patient-level data.
question: Provide pseudonymised conditions, medications and encounters for adults with atrial fibrillation.
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Atrial fibrillation = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I48.
Report the size of the cohort you would make available.
